term: strict, non-backward simultaneous, and backward event profiles
definition: StrictForward requires C e f → clock e < clock f. NoBackward requires C e f → ¬ clock f < clock e. HasSimultaneous supplies an edge at equal clock values; HasBackward supplies an edge with target clock strictly before source clock. DirectionFork is StrictForward ∨ (NoBackward ∧ HasSimultaneous) ∨ HasBackward. DirectionExclusive separately forbids each pair of horns. Framework quantifies over a common event carrier and linearly ordered time carrier and certifies coverage, pairwise incompatibility and StrictForward → EventAcyclic. These are semantic conditions, not names of exhaustive metaphysical theories.
